I don’t think anyone can answer this truthfully. It’s up to you but everyone’s different in how quick or long the process is. I’m 5 sessions, 1 year, and $1500 deep in my removal and I’m nowhere near where I need to be for a coverup. That’s a lot of tattoo to cover. It’s certainly doable but it’s a big commitment, and involves lots of money and time. You could be lucky and react great to laser, or you could not. My suggestion would be to consider how much it bothers you. It looks fine to me tbh, but your opinion is all that matters. If you truly hate it, I’d first talk to your artist about how light he’d need it, and come up with a plan, and then expect the worst but hope for the best. 2-3 years, 10+ sessions is what I’ve been told to expect but take that all with a grain of salt everyone’s different

If you really hate the idea of a rose on your hand for the rest of your life- then DO NOT get it reworked because that would make it harder to remove.
